en: A color lithographic postcard showing a lively scene in front of a grand pavilion-like building labeled as the main wine restaurant. Numerous well‑dressed people in early 20th‑century fashion stroll and gather in an open square or fairground. Several ornate buildings with red roofs and towers stand in the background, decorated with flags. Printed captions at the bottom identify the scene as Düsseldorf 1902 and mention the Haupt Weinrestaurant, with a publisher line referencing Düsseldorf.
